g.text: Admin opens a listing's Admin view
Admin writes why and is told
Record the time and the Admin
The employer posts a new listing.
plus the one the listing is already in.
Admin changes any listing field, or this
Refuse — say the listing can no
Save. Status and place in the queue stay the same
The account's business details are untouched
Email the employer which parts changed (REQ-004-9)
